title: Stand-in font picked by measured widths: Gate A's last misses are Inter running 1-3 pt wider than the oracle's own font
gate: npm run gate (2026-11-09): oracle-turn-1040 39/39, oracle-library 20/20, oracle-main-1280 35/39, oracle-main-1600 35/39, oracle-panel-closed 10/14; every miss left is the composer's width
evidence: 41 oracle widths (fixtures/states/*, fixtures/text-metrics.json) measured in 36 faces in headless Chrome: the macOS system face (SF Pro) runs 0.52 pt off on average after tracking, Inter 0.70 and 2.88 raw; base.css sets BlinkMacSystemFont, -apple-system, Inter fallback. Three fixed words keep their own tracking (parts.tsx FIT) where SF still runs 1.2-1.6 pt off. No oracle font file read or shipped (O2)
